        }), " 读取 map。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["因此，当前源码下建议显式把重调度插件的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "metricsPeriod"

        children: "getNodeUtilization"
      }), " 可能读取不到 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "5m"
      }), " 键，得到 CPU/Memory 为 0 的默认值，进而把所有节点判断为低利用率，最终不产生 victim。这是基于源码静态阅读得到的风险判断，实际部署仍应结合 scheduler 日志和指标数据确认。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.h2, {

        children: "lowNodeUtilization"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "低利用率节点和高利用率节点",
      children: "低利用率节点和高利用率节点"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "getNodeUtilization"
      }), " 为每个节点建立一条记录，当前字段只有 CPU 和 Memory 两个实际用量维度："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",

        }), "[v1.ResourceName]", _jsx(_components.span, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["随后 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {

          children: "thresholds"
        }), "，并且节点不能是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "Unschedulable"
        }), "。"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "highThresholdFilter"
        }), " 只要有一个资源维度高于 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "targetThresholds"
        }), "，节点就会进入高利用率集合。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如，配置 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "thresholds.cpu=20"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "thresholds.memory=20"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "targetThresholds.cpu=50"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "targetThresholds.memory=50"
      }), " 时，CPU 为 15%、Memory 为 30% 的节点既不是低利用率节点，也不是高利用率节点；CPU 为 60% 的节点会进入高利用率集合，CPU 为 10%、Memory 为 15% 的节点才会进入低利用率集合。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "策略在以下情况直接返回空 victim 集合：没有低利用率节点、所有节点都是低利用率节点，或没有高利用率节点。这几个条件避免了没有目标节点时盲目驱逐。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(Mermaid, {
      chart: "flowchart TD\n    metrics[NodeInfo.ResourceUsage<br/>CPU / Memory actual usage] --> classify{逐维比较阈值}\n    classify --> low[低利用率节点<br/>所有维度 < thresholds]\n    classify --> middle[中间区间<br/>不参与本轮迁移]\n    classify --> high[高利用率节点<br/>任一维度 > targetThresholds]\n    low --> check{低节点和高节点<br/>是否同时存在?}\n    high --> check\n    check -- 否 --> none[返回空 victim<br/>不执行驱逐]\n    check -- 是 --> capacity[计算低节点可接收的资源<br/>target threshold - 当前 usage]\n    capacity --> source[按高节点用量排序<br/>从高节点选择 Pod]\n    source --> victim[按 priority / QoS 排序<br/>产生 victim Task]\n"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "节点分类使用实际用量迁移空间使用-requests",
      children: "节点分类使用实际用量，迁移空间使用 requests"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["节点是否成为 source 或 target，使用的是指标中的实际 CPU/Memory 百分比；选择一个 Pod 以后，从目标节点可接收空间中扣除的则是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "TaskInfo.Resreq"
      }), " 中的 CPU 和 Memory request。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "目标节点的可接收资源大致按照下面的概括计算："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "targetCapacity = Σ(targetThreshold × targetNodeCapacity)\n                 - Σ(current targetNodeUsage)\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["每选择一个 victim，策略再扣除这个 Task 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Resreq"
      }), "："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "remaining = targetCapacity - Σ(victim.Resreq)\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这不是单纯的“把实际使用率高的 Pod 搬到实际使用率低的节点”。它使用实际用量定位失衡节点，使用 request 估算驱逐后目标节点还能容纳多少任务。对于 requests 填写准确的离线任务，这种组合比较容易和调度器资源账本衔接；对于 request 很低但实际用量经常突发的任务，结果可能与最终运行状态有偏差。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "source-节点和-pod-的排序",
      children: "source 节点和 Pod 的排序"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "source 节点按 CPU 使用率与 Memory 使用率之和降序排列。策略优先处理整体更热的节点。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "同一个节点上的 Pod 按以下顺序排序：优先级较低的 Pod 在前；优先级相同或没有优先级时，BestEffort 优先于 Burstable，Burstable 优先于 Guaranteed。这个排序把低代价、低保护级别的 Pod 放在前面，但它仍然是单 Pod 粒度的排序，不是 Job 或 Gang 粒度的排序。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["当前代码还只把 CPU 和 Memory 放入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "resourceNames"
      }), "，没有在这条重调度路径中计算 GPU、NPU 或显存："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: "resourceNames := []v1.ResourceName{\n    v1.ResourceCPU,\n    v1.ResourceMemory,\n}\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["这意味着 GPU/NPU 集群中的设备利用率不均不会自动成为当前 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "lowNodeUtilization"
      }), " 的判断维度。一个节点可能 CPU 和 Memory 都低，但加速卡已经被占满；另一个节点可能 CPU 较高，加速卡却处于空闲。当前实现无法通过 CPU 和 Memory 完整表达这类差异。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.h2, {
      id: "shuffle-action-的驱逐流程",
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "shuffle"
      }), " Action 的驱逐流程"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "shuffle"
      }), " Action 的主体很短，流程可以直接从源码读出来："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(shuffle *Action)"
          })]
        }), " Execute(ssn *framework.Session) {\n    tasks := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "make"
        }), "([]*api.TaskInfo, ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), ")\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, jobInfo := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " ssn.Jobs {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, taskInfo := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " jobInfo.Tasks {\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " taskInfo.Status == api.Running {\n                tasks = ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "append"
        }), "(tasks, taskInfo)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    victims := ssn.VictimTasks(tasks)\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " victim := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " victims {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " err := ssn.Evict(victim, ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "\"shuffle\""
        }), "); err != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "结论",
      children: "结论"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Volcano 的重调度机制处理的是初始调度结果与运行时资源状态之间的偏差。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "lowNodeUtilization"
      }), " 读取节点 CPU、Memory 实际用量，把节点分为低利用率和高利用率两组，再按照优先级、QoS 和 Task request 选择运行中的 victim；", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "shuffle"
      }), " 调用 cache 执行驱逐，使控制器和 Volcano Scheduler 有机会重新创建和放置 Pod。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["当前实现的范围比较窄：策略注册表里只有 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "lowNodeUtilization"
      }), "，重调度路径只计算 CPU 和 Memory，指标窗口存在设计文档与源码的口径差异，victim 选择仍然是 Task 粒度。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这套实现可以作为 Volcano 内部重调度的基础，但离通用的生产方案还有距离。驱逐策略需要结合 PDB、任务恢复能力、迁移冷却时间、设备与拓扑约束，并在驱逐前确认后续确实存在可行的放置位置。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {

            children: "rescheduling"
          }), " plugin"]
        })
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: _jsxs(_components.a, {

    })]
  });
}
function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
function _missingMdxReference(id, component) {
  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
